mapper.select: select a.business_no ,a.client_name ,a.president ,a.client_reg_date ,a.client_type ,a.client_type_name ,a.trade_type ,a.respon_sales_biz ,a.establish_date ,a.business_type ,a.business_item ,a.tel_no ,a.fax_no ,a.homepage ,a.email ,a.manager_id ,a.group_cd ,a.group_name ,a.groups_cd ,a.groups_name ,a.payment_cd ,a.payment_name ,a.manager_rank ,a.manager_rank2 ,a.client_id ,( SELECT min(cm.contract_date) FROM tb_contract_mst cm WHERE cm.client_id = a.client_id ) AS firstDealDate from tb_client_mst a where a.client_id = #{clientId}

SELECT client_approval_id AS clientApprovalId ,client_id AS clientId ,approval_option AS approvalOption ,first_amt AS firstAmt ,middle_amt AS middleAmt ,last_amt AS lastAmt ,credit AS credit ,credit_period AS creditPeriod ,payment_method AS paymentMethod ,reg_id AS regId ,reg_dt AS regDt ,upd_id AS updId ,upd_dt AS updDt FROM tb_client_approval WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY ISNULL(order_dist, 999999), client_approval_id

SELECT client_deal_id AS clientDealId ,client_id AS clientId ,year AS year ,sales_amt AS salesAmt ,deal_amt AS dealAmt ,order_qty AS orderQty ,manager_name AS managerName ,last_deal_date AS lastDealDate ,order_dist AS orderDist FROM tb_client_deal WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY ISNULL(order_dist, 999999), client_deal_id

SELECT client_manager_id AS clientManagerId ,client_id AS clientId ,business_manager_name AS businessManagerName ,reg_date AS regDate ,brand_name AS brandName ,dept_name AS deptName ,manager_name AS managerName ,job_positon AS jobPosition ,tel AS tel ,direct_tel AS directTel ,email AS email ,homepage AS homepage ,workplace AS workplace ,order_dist AS orderDist FROM tb_client_manager WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY ISNULL(order_dist, 999999), client_manager_id

SELECT client_address_id AS clientAddressId ,client_id AS clientId ,address_type AS addressType ,location AS location ,address AS address ,order_dist AS orderDist ,reg_id AS regId ,reg_dt AS regDt ,upd_id AS updId ,upd_dt AS updDt FROM tb_client_address WHERE client_id = #{clientId} ORDER BY ISNULL(order_dist, 999999), client_address_id

SELECT client_history_id AS clientHistoryId ,client_id AS clientId ,manager_name AS managerName ,change_date AS changeDate ,history_contents AS historyContents ,order_dist AS orderDist ,reg_id AS regId ,reg_dt AS regDt ,upd_id AS updId ,upd_dt AS updDt FROM tb_client_history WHERE client_id = CONVERT(NVARCHAR(19), #{clientId}) ORDER BY ISNULL(order_dist, 999999), client_history_id
